people.name: Joppa
people.line: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem

translations.web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
translations.bsb: He explained what had happened and sent them to Joppa.
translations.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
translations.asv: and having rehearsed all things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
